response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web developer, but the profile is a poor match for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has minimal recent C/UNIX systems programming (brief C/C++ stint in 2014–2015), and shows no evidence of Linux kernel source modification, L2/L3 switching, or security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X. His career trajectory centers on web platforms, TypeScript/Node.js, and DLang services rather than embedded firmware.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, and systems
Some low-level exposure: DLang low-latency services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux proficiency
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and open-source contributions
concerns: No native-level Japanese proficiency, a hard requirement for the role
No demonstrated experience with Linux kernel internals, embedded firmware, or switch/networking hardware
Core stack (TypeScript/Node.js, web platforms) is far from C-based embedded security development

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking/security or Linux kernel experience
